name: ecommerce-microservices
description: Order-Inventory-Payment microservices with a saga-orchestrated checkout

scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix apps/api-gateway && npm run build --prefix apps/users-service && npm run build --prefix apps/catalog-service && npm run build --prefix apps/inventory-service && npm run build --prefix apps/orders-service && npm run build --prefix apps/payments-service
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix apps/users-service -- --passWithNoTests && npm test --prefix apps/catalog-service -- --passWithNoTests && npm test --prefix apps/inventory-service -- --passWithNoTests && npm test --prefix apps/orders-service -- --passWithNoTests && npm test --prefix apps/payments-service -- --passWithNoTests
